ops.new: The proposed O&M Operator shall be a member of the Bidder and shall hold, from Financial Close until the second anniversary of PCOD, not less than ten per cent (10%) of the shares in the Project Company.

ops.note: new Portal consent application procedure for admitting O&M Operator as member, not later than 4 Working Days before Proposal Due Date
notice of intention within 5 Working Days of the date of this Addendum
notify within 2 Working Days if O&M Operator ceases to be member before Preferred Bidder Notification

payload.what_is_unsupported: A deletion in 4.1 paired with a substitution in 4.2 on an image-read declaration cannot be expressed as one valid op; a person must decide the op form. Also open: how 'استبعاد العرض' maps to the pack's rejection/non-responsive categories.
payload.why: 4.1 deletes the fourth declaration and 4.2 substitutes a new one. The engine's replace_text requires the old and new words in the same provision (C21); here they are in separate provisions, and the target is an image reading (page 6). I looked at the crop: declaration 4 is the Arabic sentence ending 'يؤدي إلى استبعاد العرض.' and it matches the text quoted in 4.1.
